steps.activity: Lead Investigator plan and scope the investigation: define the allegation, the investigation objectives, scope/limits, the investigation team (and independence/conflict-recusal), the evidence sources, and the investigation plan/SLA
steps.r: Lead Investigator / Ethics & Compliance Officer / Legal

steps.activity: Lead Investigator collect and preserve evidence: documents/records, system/transaction data, email/communications, CCTV (links to VS-23.2), access/system logs, and physical evidence; preserve chain-of-custody and apply legal-hold (links to VS-88.2)

Lead Investigator manage investigation confidentiality and need-to-know, coordinate with IT for data extraction (links to VS-27.3), and document the evidence record in case-management (links to W3720); flag any need for forensic specialists

steps.activity: Lead Investigator/HR plan and conduct interviews: identify interview subjects (reporter, accused, witnesses), schedule confidentially, conduct interviews per protocol (two interviewers, note-taking/recording where lawful), and protect witness confidentiality

Lead Investigator manage subject/witness rights and protections: ensure fairness, the right to representation (union/links to VS-84 where applicable), protection from retaliation (links to W3725), and HR/legal compliance with labor law (links to VS-19/VS-84)
Lead Investigator document interview statements, assess credibility/consistency, reconcile with evidence (W3721), and identify follow-up leads; manage witness support throughout

fields.Participants: Lead Investigator, Ethics & Compliance Officer, Legal (links to VS-100.3), HR (links to VS-19), Ethics Committee (links to W3719), Audit (links to VS-21), Risk (links to VS-21.2)

- operational: thorough investigation and control-improvement; operational: Ethics Committee independence

- **Adjudication-bias risk**: Senior subjects shielded from consequence; mitigated by Ethics Committee independence
System Touchpoints: - Case-management (links to W3720); legal (links to VS-100.3); HR (links to VS-19); Ethics Committee (links to W3719); governance (links to VS-36); audit/risk (links to VS-21.2)

steps.activity: Lead Investigator prepare the investigation report: findings of fact, evidence, witness statements, the conclusion (substantiated / unsubstantiated / inconclusive), root cause, and recommended action — documented objectively and defensibly

Ethics & Compliance Officer/Ethics Committee adjudicate: review the report, confirm the conclusion, decide on action (links to W3724), manage any dissent/appeal, and for high-severity cases escalate to the Ethics Committee (W3719) and board (links to VS-36)

Ethics & Compliance Officer communicate the outcome to the reporter (where appropriate and lawful) and the subject per process, manage confidentiality, and trigger disciplinary/corrective action (W3724); document the adjudication in case-management (links to W3720)

fields.Participants: Ethics & Compliance Officer, HR (links to VS-19/VS-84), Legal (links to VS-100.3), LP (links to VS-23), the subject's management, Audit (links to VS-21), Risk (links to VS-21.2), Finance/Recovery (links to VS-17)

steps.activity: Ethics & Compliance Officer/HR determine and execute disciplinary action proportionate to the substantiated misconduct: coaching/warning, reprimand, reassignment, suspension, or termination (links to VS-19.5/VS-84 due-process), following labor-law due process (links to VS-84)

Ethics & Compliance Officer drive corrective/remediation action on root cause: control/process fix, policy update (links to W3714), system change, training (links to W3718), and where a control failed, an audit follow-up (links to VS-21); pursue financial recovery where loss occurred (links to VS-17/VS-23)
steps.r: Ethics & Compliance Officer / Internal Controls / Audit

steps.activity: Ethics & Compliance Officer/Audit verify action completion and effectiveness, manage any appeals/grievances (links to VS-84.2), and document the action in case-management (links to W3720); report serious actions to the Ethics Committee (W3719) and board (links to VS-36)

fields.Participants: Ethics & Compliance Officer, HR (links to VS-19/VS-84), Legal (links to VS-100.3), the reporter/witness's management, Risk (links to VS-21.2), Board Audit Committee (links to VS-36)
fields.Trigger: Reporter/witness/investigator involved in a case; retaliation report

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-schedule of "schedule/perf-change, transfer, exclusion" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "Ethics & Compliance Officer/HR/Legal investigate any retaliation allegation" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-post of "posture to the Ethics Committee" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: pattern monitoring; operational: independent channel and culture
Pain Points / Risks: - **Subtle-retaliation risk**: Retaliation via schedule/perf/exclusion is hard to detect; mitigated by pattern monitoring
- **Under-reporting risk**: Retaliation goes unreported; mitigated by independent channel and culture
System Touchpoints: - HR (links to VS-19/VS-84); legal (links to VS-100.3); case-management (links to W3720); risk (links to VS-21.2); governance (links to VS-36); culture/training (links to W3718)

steps.activity: Ethics & Compliance Officer/HR monitor reporters/witnesses/investigators for retaliation: track adverse actions (discipline, schedule/perf-change, transfer, exclusion) post-report for a defined period, and investigate any pattern suggestive of retaliation

Ethics & Compliance Officer/HR/Legal investigate any retaliation allegation: substantiate, take corrective action against the retaliator (links to W3724), restore/protect the reporter, and document; treat retaliation as serious misconduct itself

Ethics & Compliance Officer report retaliation incidents and protection posture to the Ethics Committee (W3719) and board audit committee (links to VS-36); reinforce anti-retaliation culture (links to W3718)

fields.Participants: Ethics & Compliance Officer, ABC/AML Officer (links to VS-86/W2943), Internal Audit (links to VS-21), Legal (links to VS-100.3), LP (links to VS-23), HR (links to VS-19), Treasury (links to VS-18), Tax (links to VS-79)

steps.activity: Ethics & Compliance Officer coordinate ABC/AML-track cases with the ABC/AML officer (links to VS-86.3/W2943): the ABC investigation (bribery, corruption, sanctions, suspicious-transaction) runs within the ABC program, the ethics program provides the speak-up channel, whistleblower coordination, and retaliation protection — W2943 is now this coordination track

Ethics & Compliance Officer manage cross-domain case integration: ensure the matter is investigated once (not duplicated), evidence is shared appropriately, confidentiality is preserved across functions, and regulatory reporting (W3727) is triggered where required (e.g., AML STR/CTR links to VS-86.2, tax links to VS-79)
